name: Shikoku 88: Fujii-dera to Shosan-ji
why: The hardest day of the Shikoku pilgrimage, 'where pilgrims fall': over forest ridges from temple 11 to temple 12, high on Mount Shosan.
book: Free. Train to Kamojima, taxi to Fujii-dera. Temple lodging at Shosan-ji.
dangers: Three big climbs, steep and slippery.

points.name: Fujii-dera
points.note: Temple 11 at the foot of the mountains.

points.name: Shosan-ji
points.note: Temple 12 among giant cedars at 700 m.
